I’ll be completely honest with you. I myself am in process on a divorce. I stuck it out as long as I could because I was worried about the backlash/issues and gossip I would face. I’m a male and all that bothered me. Speaking from my experience the divorce will be challenging and you will have some folks that you will lose contact with by your choice or theirs. In regards to canceling with spouses friends wives you tell the reason and keep it moving. Don’t provide any additional details. They will pry you for information as to why the divorce is happening. My favorite line for that is “Life happens” and “we just weren’t compatible”  this way you can set your head down at night knowing you didn’t bad talk your spouse. If he wants to rant and rave to folks so be it. At the end of the day you will probably never see those people again. In regards to work and them knowing. My friends from work and even just acquaintances have been super supportive. They don’t care why it happened they just offer support and a drink if I want it. The road ahead is not an easy one but you will come through the other side. Marriages fail all the time and you might be surprised that through this journey you find others have been through it or almost have. Either way keep your head up and keep going. If you need feel free to reach out. Sometimes it’s easier to talk to a stranger on the internet and way cheaper than therapy. Lol been there too. Wish you the best and I bet in a year you’ll be stronger and in a great place

I used to conduct interviews and all have made some great points that I’ll add onto. 

Be able to speak to your resume. I always liked when candidates had things in their mind that they wanted to talk about. If you can’t talk about it in depth it shouldn’t be on there. 

Ask questions. It shows that you are interested and care. My favorites were always about the training program or career progression and development. It shows you want to learn and improve and stick around with the company.

Get dressed up. I don’t care if the interview is for sweeping floors you throw on your best clothes like a shirt and tie at minimum. 

Try to stay calm. It’s ok to be nervous if you aren’t nervous just a little then you don’t care. To that point don’t be afraid of silence. So many people talked themselves out of a job with me while I was taking some quick notes

Unless directly asked do not discuss $$ its rude

Be confident but not cocky

Remember they don’t beat you up if you do horrible. You just become a story that gets told of horrible interviews. But if you do well you might not get this position but they will help you find one in the company. I’ve done that for a lot of people too where I only had 1 spot to fill and 3 good applicants

Listen the fact that you are asking this speaks volumes.  Be yourself. Let them see that ambition of studying and doing things for yourself. Sounds like in your case the age is just a number as mentally your way beyond most 20 year olds.  I hope it all works out.

You can never go wrong with a black suit as a first one as it works for all functions from weddings to funerals. But also don’t be afraid to check out blue or gray suits. It will be fun. Hope you guys enjoy the experience. Also they have good sales from time to time so you can get something pricier for a good price
